periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 50 degrees downward relative to the horizontal midline of the cranium.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Distinctly oval with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 1.6:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lowest point extending significantly below the horizontal eye line.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, wide U-shape at the posterior margin of the thoracic band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High, representing approximately 45 percent of the visible lateral torso profile.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A wide gap equivalent to approximately 1.8 times the horizontal width of an individual ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, uniformly rounded semicircular curvature at the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Protrusion of pink lingual tissue (tongue) from the oral cavity; significant brownish fur discoloration on the posterior lumbar and caudal regions.
